programs.title: Uri: The Surgical Strike
programs.desc: A true story of vengeance and survival takes place between the Indian army special forces and a group of terrorists who assassinated their fellow army men in a previous surgical strike. Vicky Kaushal, Paresh Rawal, Mohit Raina, Yami Gautam, Kirti Kulhari, Aditya Dhar, Aditya Dhar.
